highlights: [2.23.0] New: Customer Policy - set per-customer payment terms (due days, credit limit, early-pay discount, automatic sale discount) and automated email reminders (on the due date, repeating daily, weekly or on chosen weekdays) with your own message and optional bill PDF, payment link and ledger balance.
[2.23.0] New: Modifiable Dashboard - make the Overview page yours: pick from 15 widgets, stack cards, add or remove row bands and save the layout.
[2.23.0] New: Bill Layout Designer Window — (Ctrl+B) Modify default layouts or create your own invoice layout.
[2.23.0] Add: Auto-repair broken hash chain in log files if breakage caused by app bug
[2.23.0] Fix: Undefined attribute error in Default Bill Templat 2 causing NaN tax fields and abnormal line breaks in invoices after Edit
[2.23.0] Fix: Uncancelable bill issue after SalePage on Edit mode is closed/cancelled.
[2.23.0] Add: More meta fields are editble - report if some fields are still not editable.
[2.23.0] Add: Re-added separate Bill Summary Section in Sale Page.
[2.23.0] Add: New Beta Program - Join new Beta Program to get early access to updates and discounts.
[2.23.0] Add: Zen Mode - Bill every invoice with the same date until the stop condition triggers.
[2.23.0] New: Scheduler - now check upcoming events, assign actions and automate tasks.
[2.23.0] New: Proforma Bills - save quotes and convert them to real invoices straight from Order Manager.
[2.23.0] New: Unprinted Bills Reminder - the app now watches your bills folder and reminds you to print unprinted invoices, with one-click printing to your default printer.
[2.23.0] Changed: Discount now move to zen mode and bill settings.

[2.23.0] New: Same-Name Customers - add a customer whose name already exists as long as the GST differs; the Sale page customer dropdown shows GST/phone details so same-name customers stay distinguishable.
[2.23.0] Add: Item-wise Discount - set a per-item discount in the stock editor; the Sale page summary shows the discounted rates and clicking a summary rate fills the selected row's rate field.
[2.23.0] Add: Credit-Limit Warning on the Sale page - over-limit customers raise a warning with the outstanding balance and limit (sales are never blocked).
[2.23.0] Add: Chart Fill Colors and Tooltips - pick gradient start/stop colors for dashboard charts in Overview Customize, and hover tooltips on dashboard and Sale page graphs.
fullchange: [2.23.0] Change: Bill Layout Designer restructured — classic designer and print engine restored with the modern 3-pane shell, element classes, starter templates, section shapes, full undo/redo and a dry-run Preview
[2.23.0] Add: Auto-repair broken hash chain in log files if breakage caused by app bug
[2.23.0] Fix: Multiple genesis line hash bug
[2.23.0] Fix: Undefined attribute error in Default Bill Templat 2 causing NaN tax fields and abnormal line breaks in invoices after Edit
[2.23.0] Fix: Uncancelable bill issue after SalePage on Edit mode is closed/cancelled.
[2.23.0] Add: More meta fields are editble - report ifsome fields are still not editable.
[2.23.0] Add: Re-added separate Bill Summary Section in Sale Page.
[2.23.0] Add: New Invoice Designer
[2.23.0] Add: More secure invoice PDFs
[2.23.0] Added Invoice template preview
[2.23.0] Add: New Beta Program - Join new Beta Program to get early access to updates and discounts.
[2.23.0] Add: Cloud Login - In-app dashboard access.
[2.23.0] Add: New EULA Pages.
[2.23.0] Add: Zen Mode - Fix one bill date for all invoices (stop after selected bill numbers, a duration, or manually).
[2.23.0] Add: App status bar on the main page - Zen Mode, weather theme, kiosk and internet status at a glance.
[2.23.0] New: Scheduler - now check upcoming events, assign actions and automate tasks.

[2.23.0] New: Proforma Bills - quotes saved to proformas.json and listed under a new Proforma Bills tab in Order Manager (Shift+F5); convert any quote to a real invoice with a fresh bill number and all items prefilled.
[2.23.0] Fix: Sale page crash when Zen Mode is stopped (null zen state).

[2.23.0] New: Unprinted Bills Reminder - the bills folder is now watched live; invoices older than 5 minutes that were never printed trigger a reminder dialog (every 30 minutes) with Print Now / Print Later / Mark as Printed. Print Now spools silently to the default printer, printed bills are remembered across restarts, and bills older than 3 days are skipped.

[2.23.0] New: Modifiable Dashboard - Overview, Sale and Purchase merged into one customizable Overview page: 15 widgets (sale/purchase charts and tables, monthly-yearly-net cards, paginated order table, scheduler, file monitor, cloud usage banner, expired bills, stock alerts and more), cards can stack, row bands can be added or removed (minimum 1 band), and the layout saves to an overview recipe - widgets are not resizable.
[2.23.0] Add: Cloud Usage widget - available credit balance and emails sent at a glance on the Overview dashboard.

[2.23.0] New: Customer Policy - open a customer's ledger or bills and press Customer Policy (Ctrl+Y) to set payment terms (due days, credit limit, early-pay discount and an automatic sale discount applied when the customer is picked on the Sale page) and automated email reminders (on the due date, then repeating daily, weekly or on chosen weekdays at a set time) with your own message template and optional bill PDF, payment link and ledger balance; the default message is a plain reminder. Over-limit customers get a credit-limit warning on their card and the payment modal shows the early-pay amount. Reminders send through BBS Cloud and run even when the app is restarted (no double sends).
[2.23.0] Fix: Payment reminders and scheduler emails can now attach bills from older financial years (previously only the current year's bills could be found).

[2.23.0] Fix: Ledger table now starts with the opening balance as the first entry (used when the customer has an opening balance set, ignored otherwise), legacy opening-balance entries are labelled correctly, and the rest of the entries stay newest-first.

[2.23.0] Fix: Ledger PDF reviewed — entries print in sequential order with the opening balance on top, payments show their own entry date instead of the print date, the previous year's closing balance carries in as the next year's opening balance, and the previous closing balance is calculated correctly.
[2.23.0] Add: Ledger PDF summary box — after the ledger table a Summary box shows Total bills (Dr) and Total payments (Cr) matched against the outstanding balance, formatted in Indian number style.

[2.23.0] New: Same-Name Customers — a customer whose name already exists can be added as long as the GST differs (the new row gets its own id seeded with the GST); same-name customers get a readable GST/phone/address suffix in the Sale page dropdown so each entry is selectable and distinguishable, the field is normalized back to the real name after picking, and typing a name freehand adopts the matching-GST row when one exists.

[2.23.0] Add: Item-wise Discount — the stock item editor always offers a discount field (stored in pInfo.discount, numeric-only); the Sale page page-3 summary shows standard/last/special rates minus the discount, and clicking any summary rate copies the displayed value into the selected row's rate field and recalculates the bill.

[2.23.0] Add: Credit-Limit Warning on the Sale page — picking a customer whose outstanding balance exceeds their policy credit limit shows a red warning toast with the outstanding and limit; the sale is never blocked.

[2.23.0] Add: Chart Fill Colors and Tooltips — Overview Customize can set gradient start/stop fill colors for charts (validated 6-digit hex, saved in the overview recipe), dashboard charts and the Sale page's 6-month rate graph show hover tooltips with date/value, and the rate graph redraws on window resize.
[2.23.0] Fix: GST field auto-cap no longer appends at the end — the caret position is kept, so middle letters can be edited; typing still auto-capitalizes.
[2.23.0] Add: GST validation (warn-only, same checksum as the Sale page) and auto-capitalization in the customer portal profile modal.
[2.23.0] Add: Warning toast when a GST is changed while editing a bill/order — explains that a new customer will be created with the same name, address and phone numbers.
[2.23.0] Fix: Payment reminder emails that hit the server rate limit (HTTP 429) are postponed and retried automatically by the re-enabled 5-minute app heartbeat.
